name: edulazaro/laragents
description: AI agents for Laravel: chat sessions with automatic history compression, a provider-agnostic tool-calling loop, memories distilled from what was said, hard rules written by a person, and agents that run on a schedule or on your own events. Bring your own tools, your own models and your own credit system. Redaction, usage accounting and the provider itself are all pluggable.

suggest.edulazaro/laranon: Required if you turn on laragents.privacy.enabled: swaps personal data for markers before the prompt reaches the provider and restores it on the way back.
suggest.edulazaro/larameter: Set laragents.usage_recorder to 'larameter' and what the loop spends is metered against your plans, with no adapter to write.
